text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, I should be able to do decent enough. 
Putting up a good fight is my whole thing, 
so if I mess even that up, what's the 
point?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, but I guess I just have to accept 
that this is where my skills are at right 
now~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. We found what needs work, so 
please look forward to our next piece! 
Just kiddin'~.
choice_data_list: Yeah, if it's Nature, she'll be fine!
Don't try to hide your frustration.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. We found what needs work, so 
please look forward to our next piece! 
Just kiddin'~.
choice_data_list: Yeah, if it's Nature, she'll be fine!
Don't try to hide your frustration.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, aren't you full of confidence? 
Saying 'if it were me' with barely 
anything to back it up.
choice_data_list:
Still, I mean that from the bottom of my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"'Giving it my all' and 'I'll be fine.' 
Look at you, throwing out all the sports 
anime clichés."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Nature-san isn't the type 
to get fired up over something like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess I can give believing you a 
little shot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm not dodging the issue. 
Besides, getting frustrated alone won't 
make me faster.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Throwing a big fit of frustration just 
isn't my style...
choice_data_list: Then I'll be frustrated for you!
Then I'll be frustrated for you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, Trainer!? What are you doing!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What's that?! Are you trying to be my 
substitute? Don't show your frustration so 
openly, geez!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez, are you stupid or what? ...Ahaha.
choice_data_list: Let's definitely win next time, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Alright, alright, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather you not start screaming at me 
again. Well, no promises though!
